title: Typography: Larsseit
slide_intent: Teach designers to give a headline a consistent speaking voice across print and screens. Spacing and case affect how quickly someone can recognize and read a short phrase.
strategic_value: Larsseit can carry Slack’s headline voice through campaigns while its weight range gives designers several degrees of emphasis.
demonstration: Large mixed-case letters and numerals sit above twelve labeled upright and italic specimens. The left column distinguishes print tracking from web letter spacing.
practical_value: Use the paired specimens to choose a headline weight. Apply sentence case and match spacing to the medium under this edition’s rules.

content_islands.name: Setting directions
content_islands.spec: Place the heading above a rule. Use a narrow left column for print and web settings and a separate note on converting slide formats.

content_islands.name: Character specimen
content_islands.spec: Set the alphabet with upper- and lowercase pairs and finish with the numerals. Use the wider right-hand column so several letter shapes can be compared at display size.

content_islands.name: Weight ladder
content_islands.spec: Stack thin through extrabold with their italic partners. Align each weight name to the left of a sample phrase set in that weight.
